title: lupinus lyallii var. lobbii
intro: Lupinus lyallii var. lobbii, commonly known as the Lobb's lupine, is a flowering plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. It is native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Lobb's lupine include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-anxiety, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
